questions.question: 287 is related to 398 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 378 is related to 489. To which of the following is 852 related to, following the same logic?
questions.solution:
The logic follows here:

**(Sum of digits of the 1st number) + 111 = 2nd number.**

Given:

287 : 398

287 + 111 = 398 = 2nd number

Similarly,

852 : ?

852 + 111 = 963 = 2nd number

Hence, the correct answer is **"963"**.

questions.question: 38 is related to 49 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 64 is related to 75. To which of the following is 83 related to, following the same logic?
questions.solution:

**Add 11 to the first number to get the second number.**

Given:

38 : 49

Similarly,

83 : ?

83 + 11 = 94 = 2nd number

Hence, the correct answer is **"94"**.

questions.question:

questions.solution:
Given the series:

16, 65, 261, 1045, 4181, ?

The pattern can be identified as multiplying the previous number by 4 and then adding 1:

16 × 4 + 1 = 65

65 × 4 + 1 = 261

261 × 4 + 1 = 1045

1045 × 4 + 1 = 4181

4181 × 4 + 1 = 16725

Hence, **"16725"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the word-pair that best represents a similar relationship to the one expressed in the pair of words given below.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants /vowels in the word)

Reflection : Light
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Reflection : Light**

→ Reflection is a phenomenon caused by Light.

Similarly,

**Echo : Sound**

→ Echo is a phenomenon caused by Sound.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Echo : Sound"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Sentiment : Feeling → This pair doesn’t fit as sentiment is essentially a type of feeling, not a phenomenon caused by feeling.
 
• Iris : Sight → This pair doesn’t fit perfectly. While the iris is a part of the eye that helps control the amount of light entering, it's not a phenomenon caused by sight; it's part of the mechanism.
 
• Movie : Scene → This pair doesn’t fit as a movie is made up of scenes, but it’s not a phenomenon caused by a scene.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion/s logically follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements:**

All rags are carpets.

Some carpets are steel.

Some steel are bottles.

**Conclusion I:** All carpets are rags.

**Conclusion II: **Some carpets are bottles.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59ad946ccf846611c002504796c47d462852eff3c37f8b23e8a8b51c18e5964b.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All carpets are rags → **False **(The statement "All rags are carpets" does not imply that all carpets are rags; it could be that some carpets are not rags.)

II. Some carpets are bottles → **False **(Based on the diagram, while some carpets and some steel overlap and some steel and some bottles overlap, there is no direct overlap shown between carpets and bottles. Hence, this conclusion does not necessarily follow from the given information.)

Hence, **neither conclusion I nor II follows​.**

questions.question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:**

All chocolates are sweets.

Some sweets are harmful.

**Conclusions:**

(I) All Chocolates are harmful.

(II) Some harmful are chocolates.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7d8c4015ae18897c225104c54dc24620a7f6c049f96fa02152b73880b8927f3.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All chocolates are harmful → **False** (It is possible but not definite. The overlap between some sweets and harmful does not necessarily include all chocolates.)

II. Some harmful are chocolates → **False** (It is possible but not definite. While there is overlap between some sweets and harmful, there is no guarantee that this overlap includes chocolates.)

Hence, **neither conclusion I nor II follows​.**

questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘ENVY' is coded as ‘FMWX' and 'ALAS' is coded as ‘BKBR’. What is the code for 'BODY' in the given code language?
questions.solution:
Here's the explanation presented in the requested format:

**Logic:**If a letter is in an odd position (e.g., first, third), it is shifted forward by one position in the alphabet.

If a letter is in an even position (e.g., second, fourth), it is shifted backward by one position in the alphabet.

'ENVY' is coded as ‘FMWX’,

E → F (+1)

N → M (-1)

V → W (+1)

Y → X (-1)

And 'ALAS' is coded as ‘BKBR’.

A → B (+1)

L → K (-1)

A → B (+1)

S → R (-1)

Similarly, 'BODY' will be coded by using the same logic.

B → C (+1)

O → N (-1)

D → E (+1)

Y → X (-1)

Hence, the correct answer is "**CNEX**".
tags: Coding and Decoding By Letter Shifting

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

P _ _ PO _ P _ P _ OP
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is: P _ _ PO _ P _ P _ OP

Option 1) POPPO

P__** PO**__/ P O__** P**__/ P __**P**__P/ __**P**__ OP

Pattern: PPO → Does not complete series correctly.

Option 2) POOOP

P __**PO**__/ P O __**O**__/ P__**O**__ P/ __**P**__O P 

Pattern: PPO → Does not complete series correctly.

Option 3) OOOPP

P __**OO**__/ PO__**O**__/ P__**P**__P/ __**P**__OP 

Pattern: POO → Does not complete series correctly.

Option 4) OPPOP

P __**OP**__/ P O__**P**__/ P __**O**__P/__** P**__ OP 

Pattern: POP → Follows pattern and completes series correctly.

Hence, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.
